name: Cactus Gardisto Idocrase
original_name: キャクタス・ガルディスト＝アイドクレイス
source: Once a member of the King's Ears, after his best friend was used as a sacrificial pawn in a failed mission, he chose to disappear and began living in his friend's home village.  Plagued by nightmares of his friend's death, he spends his days protecting the village quietly by night while playing the lazy young guy during the day.  While he is generally easygoing on the surface, he has a cold-blooded side leftover from his days as a spy and assassin for the King.
